rules: Headings (h1-h3) MUST use Playfair Display. Use font-normal or font-medium, never bold.
Body text and UI elements MUST use Manrope.
Numbers and Data (Prices, Years) MUST use Manrope with tabular-nums class.
Use tracking-tight for all headings larger than 24px.
Use tracking-widest for all OVERLINE text (uppercase labels).

layout_strategies.landing_page: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical. Use large hero image of watch movement.
layout_strategies.valuation_tool: Mode B: Control Room Grid. Dense, data-heavy, clear hierarchy.

buttons.primary: rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold px-8 py-4 bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-xs font-bold px-8 py-4 border border-white/20 hover:border-primary hover:text-primary transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/5 hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors duration-300 rounded-sm

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none px-0 py-4 focus:border-primary focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-white/20 transition-all

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}

images.description: Macro shot of Patek Philippe movement. Use with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80) for Hero section background.
Man in suit with luxury watch. Use for 'Who is this for' or 'About' section.
Close up watch on black surface. Use for Valuation Tool placeholder or sidebar.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React. Thin stroke width (1.5px) for elegance.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Implement the dark navy theme in tailwind.config.js exactly as specified in the colors section.
3. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
4. LAYOUT: Build the Landing Page using the 'Tetris Grid' philosophy. Do not stack everything in a single column.
5. VALUATION FORM: This is the core feature. Split it into steps or use a very clean, spacious grid. Do not make it look like a Google Form. Use the 'Underlined Input' style defined in components.
6. RESULTS: The valuation result should look like a stock certificate or a high-end bank statement. Use the 'Gold' color for the estimated value.
7. DISCLAIMER: Must be visible but subtle (text-xs text-muted-foreground) at the bottom of the valuation card.
8. NAVIGATION: Simple, sticky header with glassmorphism. Logo on left (Serif font), 'Valuate' button on right (Gold pill).
9. UNIVERSAL: Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid deep colors.
Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary.
Never use pure black (#000000), use the deep navy (#0B0C10) defined.
Animations should be slow and smooth (duration-500 or duration-700).
